versos.grego: Τὸν δὲ ἀσθενοῦντα τῇ πίστει προσλαμβάνεσθε, μὴ εἰς διακρίσεις διαλογισμῶν.

controles.web: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
controles.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
controles.livre: Recebei a quem for fraco na fé, mas não para envolvê-lo em temas controversos.

versos.grego: ὃς μὲν πιστεύει φαγεῖν πάντα, ὁ δὲ ἀσθενῶν λάχανα ἐσθίει.

controles.web: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
controles.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
controles.livre: Um crê que pode comer de tudo, e outro, que é fraco, come somente vegetais.

versos.grego: ὁ ἐσθίων τὸν μὴ ἐσθίοντα μὴ ἐξουθενείτω, ὁ δὲ μὴ ἐσθίων τὸν ἐσθίοντα μὴ κρινέτω, ὁ Θεὸς γὰρ αὐτὸν προσελάβετο.

controles.web: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
controles.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
controles.livre: O que come não despreze o que não come, e o que não come não julgue o que come, porque Deus o aceitou.

versos.grego: σὺ τίς εἶ ὁ κρίνων ἀλλότριον οἰκέτην; τῷ ἰδίῳ κυρίῳ στήκει ἢ πίπτει· σταθήσεται δέ, δυνατεῖ γὰρ ὁ Κύριος στῆσαι αὐτόν.

controles.web: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
controles.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
controles.livre: Quem és tu para julgares o servo alheio? É ao seu próprio senhor que ele fica firme ou cai. E ele ficará firme, porque o Senhor é poderoso para o firmar.

versos.grego: ὃς μὲν γὰρ κρίνει ἡμέραν παρ’ ἡμέραν, ὃς δὲ κρίνει πᾶσαν ἡμέραν· ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ νοῒ πληροφορείσθω.

controles.web: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
controles.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
controles.livre: Um faz diferença entre um dia e outro; porém outro considera iguais todos os dias. Cada um mantenha certeza em sua própria mente.

versos.grego: ὁ φρονῶν τὴν ἡμέραν Κυρίῳ φρονεῖ· καὶ ὁ ἐσθίων Κυρίῳ ἐσθίει, εὐχαριστεῖ γὰρ τῷ Θεῷ· καὶ ὁ μὴ ἐσθίων Κυρίῳ οὐκ ἐσθίει, καὶ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
controles.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
controles.livre: O que faz diferença entre dias, para o Senhor a faz.  O que come, come para o Senhor, porque dá graças a Deus; e o que não come, deixa de comer para o Senhor, e dá graças a Deus.

versos.grego: Οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἑαυτῷ ζῇ, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἑαυτῷ ἀποθνῄσκει·

controles.web: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
controles.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
controles.livre: Pois nenhum de nós vive para si mesmo; e nenhum morre para si mesmo.

versos.grego: ἐάν τε γὰρ ζῶμεν, τῷ Κυρίῳ ζῶμεν, ἐάν τε ἀποθνήσκωμεν, τῷ Κυρίῳ ἀποθνήσκομεν. ἐάν τε οὖν ζῶμεν ἐάν τε ἀποθνήσκωμεν, τοῦ Κυρίου ἐσμέν.

controles.web: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
controles.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
controles.livre: Porque, se vivemos, para o Senhor vivemos; e se morremos, para o Senhor morremos. Portanto, quer vivamos, quer morramos, do Senhor somos.

versos.grego: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἔζησεν, ἵνα καὶ νεκρῶν καὶ ζώντων κυριεύσῃ.

controles.web: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
controles.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
controles.livre: Pois para isto Cristo morreu, e voltou a viver, para ser Senhor tanto dos mortos como dos vivos.

versos.grego: Σὺ δὲ τί κρίνεις τὸν ἀδελφόν σου; ἢ καὶ σὺ τί ἐξουθενεῖς τὸν ἀδελφόν σου; πάντες γὰρ παραστησόμεθα τῷ βήματι τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
controles.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
controles.livre: Tu, porém, por que julgas o teu irmão? Ou tu também, por que desprezas o teu irmão? Pois todos nós seremos apresentados diante do tribunal de Deus.

versos.grego: γέγραπται γάρ Ζῶ ἐγώ, λέγει Κύριος, ὅτι ἐμοὶ κάμψει πᾶν γόνυ, καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσεται τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: For it is written,  “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
controles.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
controles.livre: Porque está escrito: “Tão certo como eu vivo, diz o Senhor, que todo joelho se dobrará diante de mim, e toda língua confessará a Deus”;

versos.grego: ἄρα οὖν ἕκαστος ἡμῶν περὶ ἑαυτοῦ λόγον δώσει τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
controles.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
controles.livre: de maneira que cada um de nós dará conta de si mesmo a Deus.

versos.grego: Μηκέτι οὖν ἀλλήλους κρίνωμεν· ἀλλὰ τοῦτο κρίνατε μᾶλλον, τὸ μὴ τιθέναι πρόσκομμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ ἢ σκάνδαλον.

controles.web: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
controles.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.
controles.livre: Portanto, não julguemos mais uns aos outros; em vez disso, decidi nunca pôr alguma pedra de obstáculo ou de tropeço diante do seu irmão.

versos.grego: οἶδα καὶ πέπεισμαι ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ ὅτι οὐδὲν κοινὸν δι’ ἑαυτοῦ· εἰ μὴ τῷ λογιζομένῳ τι κοινὸν εἶναι, ἐκείνῳ κοινόν.

controles.web: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
controles.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
controles.livre: Eu sei, e tenho certeza no Senhor Jesus, que nada é impuro por si mesmo; a não ser para quem o considera impuro: aquilo para ele se torna impuro.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ διὰ βρῶμα ὁ ἀδελφός σου λυπεῖται, οὐκέτι κατὰ ἀγάπην περιπατεῖς. μὴ τῷ βρώματί σου ἐκεῖνον ἀπόλλυε, ὑπὲρ οὗ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν.

controles.web: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
controles.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
controles.livre: Pois, se por causa do que comes  o teu irmão se entristece,  tu já não estás andando segundo o amor. Não destruas por tua comida aquele por quem Cristo morreu.

versos.grego: μὴ βλασφημείσθω οὖν ὑμῶν τὸ ἀγαθόν.

controles.web: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
controles.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
controles.livre: Não seja insultado o vosso bem,

versos.grego: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ βρῶσις καὶ πόσις, ἀλλὰ δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ χαρὰ ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ·

controles.web: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: porque o reino de Deus não é comida nem bebida, mas sim justiça, paz, e alegria no Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ ἐν τούτῳ δουλεύων τῷ Χριστῷ εὐάρεστος τῷ Θεῷ καὶ δόκιμος τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.

controles.web: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
controles.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
controles.livre: Pois quem nisso serve a Cristo é agradável a Deus e aprovado pelas pessoas.

versos.grego: ἄρα οὖν τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης διώκομεν καὶ τὰ τῆς οἰκοδομῆς τῆς εἰς ἀλλήλους.

controles.web: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
controles.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
controles.livre: Sigamos, pois, as coisas que resultam em paz e edificação de uns aos outros.

versos.grego: μὴ ἕνεκεν βρώματος κατάλυε τὸ ἔργον τοῦ Θεοῦ. πάντα μὲν καθαρά, ἀλλὰ κακὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ διὰ προσκόμματος ἐσθίοντι.

controles.web: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
controles.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
controles.livre: Não destruas a obra de Deus por causa da comida. É verdade que todas as coisas são limpas, porém mau é ao ser humano comer causando ofensa.

versos.grego: καλὸν τὸ μὴ φαγεῖν κρέα μηδὲ πιεῖν οἶνον μηδὲ ἐν ᾧ ὁ ἀδελφός σου προσκόπτει.

controles.web: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
controles.kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
controles.livre: Não é bom comer carne, nem beber vinho, nem qualquer coisa que faça o teu irmão tropeçar.

versos.grego: σὺ πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις κατὰ σεαυτὸν ἔχε ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ. μακάριος ὁ μὴ κρίνων ἑαυτὸν ἐν ᾧ δοκιμάζει·

controles.web: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
controles.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
controles.livre: A convicção que tu tens, tenha-a para ti mesmo diante de Deus. Feliz  é quem não se culpa naquilo que aprova.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ διακρινόμενος ἐὰν φάγῃ κατακέκριται, ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως· πᾶν δὲ ὃ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἁμαρτία ἐστίν.

controles.web: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.     Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages, but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations; to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.
controles.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
controles.livre: Mas aquele que tem dúvida, se comer, é culpado, porque não foi pela fé; e tudo que não é pela fé é pecado.
